gates.A: Promise/result by 3s where appropriate; every promised demo pays off; actual CTA readable.
gates.B: Real target, contact and readable result at phone size and 1x; prices include units; no overlay hides proof.
gates.C: Vietnamese meaning, diacritics, negations, names, numbers; normally <=2 lines; critical timing starts at +/-150ms.
gates.D: Purposeful animation, readable settled state, no unwanted watermark; sharp SFX peak within one output frame.
gates.E: Entire master heard at 1x, intact speech and intelligible mix; -16 LUFS +/-2, true peak <=-1 dBTP.
gates.F: Full AV decode; requested dimensions/fps/subtitles; expected frame count +/-1; exact-master and dependency hashes.

flow_scale.1: Confirmed obstruction or mismatch to this episode's intent.
flow_scale.3: Usable after a small revision; identify it with timecode.
flow_scale.4: Keep on first pass; relevant reference treatment adapted to this speech.
flow_scale.5: Keep on first pass; viewer identifies the intended action and payoff without replay.

pilot_targets.source: Configurable house engineering targets, not published universal standards or a power calculation.

promotion: All hard gates pass on every counted master. Compare matched complete episodes, not scenes as independent samples. A candidate needs paired evidence against rules and base+same RAG, no quality regression, uncertainty intervals and actual review before production promotion. This file never promotes a model.
feedback: Keep frozen test groups out of training AND RAG. Approved corrections from development groups can enter the next versioned dataset. If a test group is retired for learning, record that decision and replace it with new unseen groups before another generalization claim.
